feedback.worked_solution:
To find the points where the hyperbola intersects the line $y=2.5,$ we substitute $y=2.5$ into the equation of the hyperbola and solve for $x,$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}4{y}^{2}-{x}^{2} & =16 \\ 4(2.5)^{2}-{x}^{2} & =16 \\ 25-{x}^{2} & =16 \\ -{x}^{2} & =16-25 \\ -{x}^{2} & =-9 \\ {x}^{2} & =9 \\ x & =\pm 3\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, from left to right, the hyperbola intersects the vertical line $y=2.5$  at the points $(-3,2.5)$ and $(3,2.5).$
